sloka: ततस्तान् राक्षसान् सर्वान् हर्षयन् रावणात्मजः।स्तुवानो हर्षमाणश्च इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.९१.४ ।।
transliteration: tatastān rākṣasān sarvān harṣayan rāvaṇātmajaḥ।stuvāno harṣamāṇaśca idaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.91.4 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana's son, praising all the Rakshasas making them happy, spoke these words.
